text: {"label":"Assessment and Treatment of Stereotypy","definition":"Research on assessing and reducing stereotypy, mostly motor and automatically maintained, in autistic individuals, using competing stimuli, redirection, response blocking, noncontingent reinforcement, skill-based and parent-implemented interventions.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers stereotypy broadly, especially motor forms, unlike the vocal-stereotypy topic, the topic on competing stimulus assessment methods, and the topic on auditory stimulus discrimination."}
